overall_reason: A sync-status card with a confirmation toast: the card itself groups well, but the toast's top edge lands 1px inside the card's bottom edge, so the two objects neither join nor separate.

score.reason: T-SQUINT passes (title, two rows, then the toast), but T-LEFT-EDGES and T-DELETION find the toast touching the card at a near-tangent.

findings.where: toast 'All files synced' against the 'Workspace sync' card, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json the card spans y=24 to 162 and the toast starts at y=161, so the toast overlaps the card's bottom border by 1px. 01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png and 01-evidence/tiles/375-00.png show the toast's top edge sitting on the card's bottom edge.
findings.before: Toast top edge 1px inside the card's bottom edge (card bottom y=162, toast top y=161).
findings.after: Part the toast from the card by at least the card gutter (about 12 to 16px), or make it straddle the card edge clearly as a satellite.
findings.why: Edges 1 to 3px apart read as a rendering accident, and the reader cannot tell whether the toast belongs to the card or floats above the page.

strengths: The card holds one clear group: title, then two label and status rows on a shared left edge at x=413 and a shared right edge.
The phone order at 375 matches the 1440 order exactly.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent from the run, so the visitor mode was inferred from the artifact: a single product composition (card, window or scene), judged as a component in Operate terms
T-FIVE-SECOND, T-SCREEN-BY-SCREEN, T-HEADINGS-READ, T-STOCK-ORDER, T-COMPOSITION-RUN and T-ANATOMY: the artifact is one composition on one tile, with no page, fold or section sequence
